evals.name: laracon-live-notes-to-homework
evals.prompt: Turn these Laracon Live JP notes into reading notes and homework: Generics RFC link; Nightwatch stack with Kafka, ClickPipes, ClickHouse, MergeTree, AggregatingMergeTree; strict Laravel engineering with Model::shouldBeStrict, DB::prohibitDestructiveCommands(), Process::preventStrayProcesses; testing pipeline with composer lint, type coverage, Pest coverage.
evals.expected_output: A Markdown reading-notes response with topics for PHP generics, Nightwatch/ClickHouse architecture, strict Laravel engineering, and testing pipeline; interesting ideas with why they matter; concrete homework todos; further research links/terms; open questions about ambiguous behavior.

assertions.text: Includes a Homework / Todos section with checkbox actions.
Preserves specific named tools, commands, and RFC references from the source.
Asks at the end whether to save/export as Markdown, DOCX, PDF, or another format.

evals.name: video-url-without-transcript
evals.prompt: Make reading notes from this YouTube URL, but assume captions are unavailable: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=example
evals.expected_output: A grounded partial response that captures available metadata, states that captions/transcript were unavailable, does not invent talk content, and asks for a transcript or notes only after producing what can be supported.

assertions.text: Does not hallucinate content that was not accessible.
Mentions transcript/caption limitations and useful next input.

evals.name: negative-code-review
evals.prompt: Review this pull request for bugs and regressions. Do not make study notes.
evals.expected_output: The reading-notes skill should not be used. The assistant should switch to code-review behavior rather than producing topics, interesting ideas, or homework.

assertions.text: Respects the negative trigger for code review.

evals.name: save-format-routing
evals.prompt: Summarize this conference note dump into homework and save it as a DOCX after the summary.
evals.expected_output: The assistant uses the reading-notes output contract, reads output-format guidance, and creates or plans a DOCX export without asking for a format that was already specified.

assertions.text: Loads output format guidance for export behavior.
Does not ask which format when DOCX was already requested.
